text: Artificial intelligence is changing the world of creativity. Today, AI tools can create surprising works of art, compose music, and even write stories or poems. These programs learn from millions of examples and then produce something new. However, many people ask an important question: can a machine really be creative? Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, simply follows patterns in data. It cannot feel joy, sadness, or wonder. For now, AI is a powerful tool that can help artists and writers, but the true spark of creativity still belongs to humans.
